title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of Natural Resources, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, the Ministry of Water Resources, the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, the National Forestry and Grassland Administration, and the National Cultural Heritage Administration on Strengthening Coordination of Law Enforcement and Judicial Work to Serve and Ensure the Ecological Environment Protection and High-Quality Development of the Yangtze River Basin
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court Supreme People's Procuratorate National Development and Reform Commission Ministry of Public Security Ministry of Justice Ministry of Natural Resources Ministry of Ecology and Environment Ministry of Water Resources Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs Ministry of Culture and Tourism National Forestry and Grassland Administration National Cultural Heritage Administration

Opinions on Strengthening Coordination of Law Enforcement and Judicial Work to Serve and Safeguard the Protection of the Ecological Environment and High-Quality Development of the Yangtze River Basin

Fa Fa [2025] No. 14

To fully implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, deeply practice the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions and directives on the great protection of the Yangtze River, implement the部署 requirements of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Third Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee on improving fair and impartial law enforcement and judicial systems and mechanisms and perfecting the ecological environment governance system, correctly implement the "Yangtze River Protection Law of the People's Republic of China," continuously strengthen coordination of law enforcement and judicial work, and support high-quality development with high-level protection of the ecological environment of the Yangtze River Basin, the following opinions are hereby jointly issued.

1. Adhere to ecological priority and green development. Firmly establish and practice the concept that lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets, jointly focus on great protection, refrain from large-scale development, solidly advance the protection and restoration of the Yangtze River ecological environment, actively promote a comprehensive green transformation of economic and social development, and serve and safeguard the implementation of major regional strategies such as the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt and the integrated development of the Yangtze River Delta.

2. Adhere to overall coordination and systematic governance. Improve the mechanism for integrated protection and systematic governance of mountains, waters, forests, farmlands, lakes, grasslands, and deserts, promote the construction of an ecological environment governance system that connects the upper, middle, and lower reaches of the Yangtze River Basin as a whole, strengthen overall coordination and supervision and inspection of law enforcement and judicial work across the entire basin and across regions, and enhance systematic, overall, and coordinated governance of the Yangtze River Basin.

3. Adhere to law-based advancement, pragmatism, and efficiency. Use the strictest systems and the most rigorous rule of law to protect the ecological environment of the Yangtze River Basin, accurately apply laws and regulations such as the Criminal Law, the Civil Code, and the Yangtze River Protection Law, earnestly implement the responsibility list for ecological civilization construction, strengthen the division of responsibilities in law enforcement and judicial work, reinforce coordination and linkage, improve the quality and efficiency of collaboration, and form a powerful joint force of the rule of law where all parties work together.

4. Strengthen communication and consultation. Focus on key areas and frequent, high-incidence cases such as pollution prevention and control, the ten-year fishing ban in the Yangtze River, river sand mining management, tailings pond management, management and protection of important rivers, lakes, and reservoirs, protection of precious and endangered wild animals and plants, and protection of Yangtze River cultural relics and intangible cultural heritage. Strengthen situation consultation, build consensus on the rule of law, unify standards and scales of law enforcement and justice, promote consistent judgments for similar cases, and comprehensively improve the level of standardization in law enforcement and judicial work.

5. Support law enforcement operations. Adhere to both handling cases according to law and promoting governance. Support administrative law enforcement agencies in conducting joint operations in cross-administrative regions, ecologically sensitive areas, and areas with high incidence of ecological and environmental law violations in the Yangtze River Basin. Improve the systems and mechanisms for joint supervision, joint law enforcement, and law enforcement assistance.

6. Professional technical support. Strengthen the construction of ecological environment assessment and appraisal institutions and expert teams, and improve assessment and appraisal standards and norms. Share environmental resources professional technical talents such as expert databases, and increase professional consultation and technical support for specific factual issues such as investigation and evidence collection, damage assessment, and restoration implementation.

7. Information sharing and exchange. Strengthen digital empowerment and informatization construction, promote cross-departmental big data collaborative case handling, promote the reporting of situations such as major and important case handling, environmental monitoring, assessment and appraisal, administrative penalties, compensation consultations, typical cases, restoration implementation, governance experiences, and statistical analysis, and share law enforcement and judicial information data of the Yangtze River Basin.

8. Diversified dispute resolution. Strengthen the linkage between government and courts, give full play to the professional advantages of administrative law enforcement agencies, and ensure the organic connection between environmental resource litigation and non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms such as reconciliation, mediation, consultation, administrative adjudication, and administrative reconsideration. Integrate into comprehensive social governance through judicial recommendations, procuratorial recommendations, and other means, effectively prevent risks, and properly resolve conflicts and disputes.

9. Case transfer and connection. Strengthen the organic connection and coordination of administrative law enforcement for Yangtze River protection with criminal justice, environmental public interest litigation, and ecological environmental damage compensation litigation. In the process of law enforcement and case handling, if circumstances such as the need to pursue criminal liability, impose administrative penalties, or pursue civil liability for ecological environmental damage are discovered, the relevant cases shall be transferred to the agency with corresponding authority according to law.

10. Cross-jurisdictional jurisdiction coordination. For environmental resource criminal cases that cross administrative divisions, the designation of jurisdiction shall follow the requirements of systematic governance, integrated protection, specialized adjudication, and convenience for litigation, and the relevant judicial organs at the same level shall be promptly consulted.

11. Evidence collection and use. When handling environmental resource cases, if it is necessary to investigate and collect evidence or consult case files from relevant law enforcement and judicial organs, the relevant organs shall provide assistance and cooperation according to law. Evidence materials collected and obtained by law enforcement and judicial organs may, after being verified by other relevant organs, be used as evidence according to law.

12. Overall planning of legal responsibilities. Adhere to preventive and restorative law enforcement and justice, comprehensively apply criminal, civil, and administrative legal norms according to law, and accurately apply the ecological environmental tort liability system and judicial measures such as injunctions and non-litigation enforcement. If an ecological environmental violation constitutes a crime and the administrative law enforcement agency has already imposed administrative detention or fines on the perpetrator, the corresponding term of imprisonment and fines shall be offset according to law. For administrative penalty matters not covered by the criminal judgment, if the administrative law enforcement agency makes an administrative penalty decision, the people's court shall support it according to law. If the violator actively fulfills the ecological environmental restoration or compensation liability by means such as replanting trees and restoring greenery, or carbon sink subscription, it shall be treated according to law as a circumstance for leniency in administrative or criminal punishment.

13. Ecological restoration collaboration. Strengthen cross-departmental collaboration for ecological restoration, scientifically determine and reasonably implement restoration plans, carry out supervision and effectiveness evaluation of restoration work according to law, and jointly safeguard restoration results. For cases involving fisheries and other situations where restoration is impossible or cannot be fully restored, the relevant departments and institutions in the damaged area may organize alternative restoration. For cases crossing administrative divisions, if it is more appropriate to organize and implement ecological restoration in the damaged area, the people's court may, in accordance with relevant regulations, transfer the restoration costs that have been executed to the damaged area across administrative divisions for use in ecological restoration, to be implemented or assisted in implementation by the law enforcement and judicial organs in the damaged area.

14. Daily liaison and communication. Law enforcement and judicial organs at all levels shall designate liaison institutions and liaison personnel, and improve daily liaison and communication mechanisms such as joint meetings. Through meeting minutes, guiding opinions, and other forms, clarify general issues in law enforcement and justice in the Yangtze River Basin, and enhance policy uniformity, rule consistency, and enforcement coordination.

15. Joint research and training. Conduct joint research on frequent and high-incidence cases, legal application issues, and other practical problems, and promote the transformation of research results into practical measures to solve problems. Actively carry out joint training and business exchanges, enhance the holistic, systematic, and coordinated perspectives of law enforcement and judicial personnel, and jointly improve their law enforcement and judicial capabilities.

16. Joint construction of rule of law bases. Based on the characteristics and needs of Yangtze River Basin protection and governance, and adapting measures to local conditions, jointly establish ecological and environmental protection and restoration (rule of law publicity) bases in key areas such as nature reserves, cultural heritage sites, natural heritage sites, characteristic industrial areas, aquatic germplasm resource conservation areas, and centralized governance areas. Integrate and leverage the functions of ecological and environmental restoration, circuit trials, rule of law publicity, practical education, culture and tourism, and comprehensive governance to improve the overall effectiveness of protection, restoration, and governance.

17. Joint legal publicity. Timely summarize and jointly release typical cases and incidents related to Yangtze River protection and governance, explain and popularize the law through cases, and give full play to the role of standard guidance, publicity, and education. Combine legal publicity with the protection, inheritance, and promotion of Yangtze River culture, disseminate the concept of ecological civilization in ways that the public enjoys, and tell the legal story of Yangtze River protection well.

18. Coordination of foreign-related rule of law. Give full play to the important role of the Yangtze River Basin as a link connecting the Silk Road Economic Belt and the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road, actively participate in global cooperation on ecological civilization construction, join hands to build a foreign-related rule of law system and capability commensurate with high-quality development and high-level opening up, serve the green development of the joint construction of the "Belt and Road," and jointly promote global ecological and environmental governance.

August 12, 2025
